description: Angular component for visualizing and interacting with transition events in a trace viewer, including timeline rendering, selection, and status display.

classes.name: ViewerTransitionsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying and interacting with transition events in a trace viewer.

methods.name: getMinOfRanges
methods.description: Calculates the minimum timestamp across all entries.

methods.name: getMaxOfRanges
methods.description: Calculates the maximum timestamp across all entries.

methods.name: formattedTime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp according to the specified timestamp type.

methods.name: formattedTimeDiff
methods.description: Calculates and formats the difference between two timestamps.

methods.name: widthOf
methods.description: Determines the width of a transition rectangle in the timeline.

methods.name: startOf
methods.description: Calculates the start position of a transition in the timeline.

methods.name: sendOf
methods.description: Calculates the send position of a transition in the timeline.

methods.name: onTransitionClicked
methods.description: Handles click events on a transition.

methods.name: transitionRectStyle
methods.description: Returns the fill style for a transition rectangle based on its state.

methods.name: transitionDividerRectStyle
methods.description: Returns the fill style for transition dividers.

methods.name: showNode
methods.description: Determines if a node should be shown in the UI tree.

methods.name: isLeaf
methods.description: Checks if a tree node is a leaf node.

methods.name: isCurrentTransition
methods.description: Checks if a transition is currently selected.

methods.name: assignRowsToTransitions
methods.description: Assigns timeline rows to transitions to avoid overlaps.

methods.name: timelineRows
methods.description: Returns the list of timeline row indices.

methods.name: transitionsOnRow
methods.description: Returns transitions assigned to a specific timeline row.

methods.name: rowsRequiredForTransitions
methods.description: Calculates the total number of rows needed for all transitions.

methods.name: emitEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a custom event with transition data.
